Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

So sorry we’re unable to cancel the order. As soon as an order is placed, our warehouse system prints the label, pre-packs the box, and arranges shipping — so it moves fast and we’re not able to cancel or modify it from there. Really sorry we can’t help on this one.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
an order is placed, our warehouse system prints the label, pre-packs the box, and arranges shipping — so it moves fast and we’re not able to cancel or modify it from there. Really sorry we can’t help on this one.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

We’re not able to add items to an order once it’s been placed. Orders move into processing right away, so they can’t be modified after checkout. If you still want the item, you’ll need to place a separate order for it.
